name: mirage
text:
Done: v1.0.125 is out. It precompiles the app's code for your tablet. After installing, open it once and wait a minute or two with it open: Android installs the profile then, so the first start may still be slow and the next ones should be much faster. Download:
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.125
Open the app a few minutes after and the next report will show whether the start time and lag dropped. I'll keep going on the Engine and +EV tabs if they still stutter.
